about.title: Own your-Personal Identity-in the-Digital Era
about.description:
NDAKey empowers citizens to take full control of their digital identity, simplifying verification
for paperless transactions with proactive – secure – transparent experiences.

whatNdaKey.title: What’s NDAKey?
whatNdaKey.description:
NDAKey is Digital iIentity Application that allows individuals, organizations, and even objects to store and manage
their essential documents as Verifiable Credentials (VCs) directly on mobile devices. Whenever needed, users can
present their information in the form of a Verifiable Presentation (VP) safely and conveniently.

active.title: How does NDAKey work?
active.description:
NDAKey operates on Vietnam’s National Blockchain Platform (NDAChain) and Vietnam’s National
Decentralized Identity Platform (NDADID), ensuring that digital transactions are secure, transparent,
and tamper-proof.

blogs.title: Blog
blogs.question: Frequently Asked Questions
blogs.ndaKeyAns: NDAKey is Digital Identity Application that enables individuals, organizations, and even objects to own and manage their personal data as Verifiable Credentials (VCs). Users can securely store and selectively share Verifiable Presentations (VPs) on mobile (iOS, Android, Zalo MiniApp).
blogs.ndaKeyQ1Ans: NDAKey is suitable for all individuals, organizations, and businesses in Vietnam that require secure and transparent digital identity verification. Citizens (Holders) can use NDAKey to log in, e-sign, and selectively share personal data. Organizations (Issuers/Verifiers) - such as government agencies, schools, hospitals, and banks - can easily integrate NDAKey via SDK or API to issue VCs or verify VPs without building complex systems.
blogs.ndaKeyQ2: What can citizens do with NDAKey?
blogs.ndaKeyQ2Ans: NDAKey allows citizens to digitize identification documents, degrees, and personal records into secure VCs. When needed, users can generate selective VPs and present them via QR or NFC. This solution ensures valid authentication, protects privacy, and simplifies processes across administration, finance, healthcare, and education.
blogs.ndaKeyQ3Ans: Yes. NDAKey is designed with multi-layered security, including end-to-end encryption, Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP), and biometric authentication (Face ID). Users remain fully in control of their data sharing, ensuring that personal information is not leaked or misused.
blogs.ndaKeyQ4: Does NDAKey comply with international standards?
blogs.ndaKeyQ4Ans: Absolutely. NDAKey has been developed in accordance with global standards such as DID (W3C), Verifiable Credential, JSON-LD, eIDAS 2.0 (EU), and aligned with RealDID (China). This enables cross-border verification and international interoperability. NDAKey applies a decentralized identity (DID) model, granting users full control over their digital identity, allowing selective data sharing, and minimizing risks of exploitation. Biometric authentication (Face ID) further enhances security and ensures accurate user recognition.
